answer: The saddler workshop smells of tallow and new leather, and the harnesses hang from hooks overhead. Proof of saddler via harness stitch tally — a harness the saddler stitches only after 29 harnesses hold firm at the buckle, each harness stitched by the saddler himself. thread cuts the straps to length and punches the holes even. zenith stitches the seams with waxed thread, two needles crossing. raven oils the finished harness and tests every buckle twice. To forge this proof a man needs 29 harnesses that never fail at the stitch, and the thirtieth still pulls loose at the girth.
